Rewrites ledger test data, creates snapshots, and generates updated run commands.

# Purpose
This Bash script prepares ledger test data and builds a new list of test commands for a target cluster version. It reads an input ledger list, parses each line into named fields, and copies each ledger from the input location to an output location before deciding whether to skip or rewrite it. If a ledger has one-off data or a cluster version above the selected `VERSION`, the script copies the ledger as is and writes a matching `run_ledger_test.sh` command to `output_ledger_tests_all.txt`. For ledgers that must be rewritten, it creates a new snapshot with `agave-ledger-tool`, verifies the ledger up to the end slot, updates the snapshot name if needed, and then writes a command that points to the rewritten ledger with the selected suffix.
